name: decibel
title: Decibel
description: A large-print hearing-clinic theme on audiogram paper: care lists and before-your-visit steps are plotted as a ruled 125–8k frequency chart whose red circles and blue crosses step one column right per row, ending on the phone number and the Book link.

tokens.--font-text: all reading text, headings and the menu (a transitional serif, set large)
tokens.--font-mono: the chart's frequency and dB figures, dates, page numbers and code
tokens.--text-s: small text: captions over contact details, table text, dates, summaries on the care index
tokens.--text-m: base body size (large print on purpose)
tokens.--text-l: site name, ledes, phone numbers, list titles and the home chart's caption
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in page text and the chart's caption on a service page
tokens.--color-bg: page background (chart-paper white); also fills the red circles so the pencil line stops at their edge, and fades the scroll edges of wide tables
tokens.--color-text: pencil-black text, the site name, menu items and the phone number in the masthead
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: ledes, captions, summaries, axis figures — and the pencil line joining the chart's markers
tokens.--color-accent: ballpoint indigo: links, the blue crosses on the chart and in the site mark, the Book button, the skip link, the current menu item, quote bars, focus rings
tokens.--color-on-accent: text on the Book button and the skip link
tokens.--color-circle: red for the chart's circles and the circle in the site mark — nothing else
tokens.--color-grid: pale grey-blue grid lines on the chart, rules above section headings, table rows, list rows and the dashed rows of the opening hours
tokens.--color-grid-faint: the faint dashed lines between chart rows
tokens.--color-frame: the darker grey-blue frame of the chart and its closing rule above the phone and Book link, the rule under the masthead and above the footer, table heads, dividers, code-block edge, the scroll hint on wide tables
tokens.--color-panel: background of code and code blocks
tokens.--chart-text: share of the chart's width given to the item text beside the plot on wide screens (the home chart widens it a little)
tokens.--chart-axis: width of the chart's dB axis column
tokens.--marker: size of a circle or cross on the chart
tokens.--stroke: line thickness of the chart's circles and crosses
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the Book button, code and focus rings (nearly square, like a printed form)
tokens.--tap: minimum touch height of links in the menu, buttons and chart rows
